title: Insulated Copper Tubes - Heat Loss
description: Heat loss to surrounding air from insulated copper tubes. The heat loss is based on temperature difference 55°C (99°F) with insulation thickness 25 mm (1 inch) and conductivity coefficient k = 0.043 W/m°C (0.3 Btu in/ft²hr°F).

components.content:
## Conversion Factors
- 1 W = 3.4 Btu/hr
- 1 ft (foot) = 0.3048 m

## Parameters
- **Temperature Difference**: 55°C (99°F)
- **Insulation Thickness**: 25 mm (1 inch)
- **Conductivity Coefficient (k)**: 0.043 W/m°C (0.3 Btu in/ft²hr°F)
